name: free-camera
description: A free camera (WM_ROM_OUT/free of rom.test.tsx: the spec level with the level's Only forward off, so backtrack is its whole width): player 1 walks right until the camera is at x 420, then left, and the camera follows back to x 101 (with Only forward it would stop 48 px back), then right again. Play mode gives the same places every frame.
